description_en: Dissociates a MACsec key from a dedicated Express Connect circuit port
description_zh: 支持在独享物理专线端口上面取消关联MacSec密钥
kebab_example: aliyun vpc disassociate-mac-sec-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-bp1hp0wr072f60000 --ckn 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisassociateMacSecKey

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit. The Express Connect circuit must be in the Enabled state and its BusinessStatus must be Normal. You can call DescribePhysicalConnections to query the circuit
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线ID。物理专线必须处于Enabled状态且BusinessStatus为Normal，可通过DescribePhysicalConnections查询
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The key name. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically converted to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters. This value must be a key name that has been associated with the target Express Connect circuit by calling AssociateMacSecKey
parameters.help_zh: 密钥名称，只支持十六进制字符，小写会自动转换为大写。当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-128或者GCM-AES-XPN-128时，长度要求为32个十六进制字符；当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-256或者GCM-AES-XPN-256时，长度要求为64个十六进制字符。该值必须是已通过AssociateMacSecKey关联到目标物理专线的密钥名称
parameters.name: ckn
